items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I tell you, Loretta Young, you ever seen her?

ctx.x: Her personality. Doll! she was a doll. She was doll from A to Z. We used to chatter and play cards. She was right in the middle of it. And lucky, oh my God. We buy a new car every year, she used to just wash us away. Expert gambler. That's right. And a doll. We want to go out cabareting, she said I'm going too, said all right, no matter, she'd come and go. Said I want to go too, and she was the only girl and we had the guys like her brother and she went everywhere with us.

And partner, Ivie Anderson, I tell you, I can recall it like it was yesterday, Ivie Anderson, when she walked up on the stage, the way she -- when she come on the stage from the side, and walking straight, before she said a word, she got the people in the palm of her hand. I tell you, Loretta Young, you ever seen her?
